import pandas as pd

# Load the datasets
time_series_df = pd.read_csv('/data/time_series_data.csv')
capital_df = pd.read_csv('/data/capital.csv')
pollen_df = pd.read_csv('/data/pollen_openness_score_Belau_Woserin_Feeser_et_al_2019.csv')

# Focus on the AxesCelts and AxesCelts_inter columns in the time_series_data.csv dataset
axes_celts_data = time_series_df[['CE', 'AxesCelts', 'AxesCelts_inter']]

# Determine the century in which Axes & Celts peaked
# First, find the maximum value in the AxesCelts_inter column
max_axes_celts_inter = axes_celts_data['AxesCelts_inter'].max()

# Find the corresponding CE value for the maximum AxesCelts_inter
max_axes_celts_inter_ce = axes_celts_data.loc[axes_celts_data['AxesCelts_inter'] == max_axes_celts_inter, 'CE'].values[0]

# Determine the century
century = max_axes_celts_inter_ce // 100

# Print the century
century

pollen_df = pd.read_csv('/data/pollen_openness_score_Belau_Woserin_Feeser_et_al_2019.csv')

# Focus on the AxesCelts and AxesCelts_inter columns in the time_series_data.csv dataset

pollen_df = pd.read_csv('/data/pollen_openness_score_Belau_Woserin_Feeser_et_al_2019.csv')

# Determine the maximum value in the AxesCelts_inter column
max_axes_celts_inter = axes_celts_data['AxesCelts_inter'].max()

# Find all CE values where AxesCelts_inter is close to the maximum value
close_max_values = axes_celts_data[axes_celts_data['AxesCelts_inter'] >= max_axes_celts_inter - 0.1]

# Print the CE values and their corresponding AxesCelts_inter values
close_max_values[['CE', 'AxesCelts_inter']]

import pandas as pd

# Load the capital dataset
capital_df = pd.read_csv('/data/capital.csv')

# Focus on the ZBeil column (Axes & Celts)
z_beil_data = capital_df[['BCE', 'ZBeil']]

# Determine the minimum BCE value (since BCE is negative, the minimum is the most recent)
min_bce = z_beil_data['BCE'].min()

# Find the corresponding ZBeil value for the minimum BCE
max_z_beil = z_beil_data.loc[z_beil_data['BCE'] == min_bce, 'ZBeil'].values[0]

# Determine the century
century = (min_bce // 100) * -1

# Print the century
century
